theses.name: Crowded Short Squeeze
theses.precondition: Funding under -0.02% for three consecutive settlements while open interest adds more than 4% in an hour. Shorts are crowded and paying, so take the squeeze long.

theses.name: Open Interest Breakout
theses.precondition: Open interest up more than 6% while price clears the prior 4 hour high and taker buy ratio holds above 0.58. Enter on the retest, not the break.

theses.name: Basis Reversion
theses.precondition: Quarterly basis stretched past 1.4 standard deviations annualized while spot volume stays flat. Short the perp, hold to the mean or 36 hours, whichever lands first.

theses.name: Liquidation Sweep Reclaim
theses.precondition: Price sweeps a 24 hour liquidity pocket, prints more than 2M USDT of liquidations inside 5 minutes, then reclaims the swept level within 3 candles.

theses.name: Post Event Volatility Crush
theses.precondition: The implied move is already realized within 30 minutes of a scheduled macro print. Sell the expansion back toward the pre-event mean.

theses.name: Trend Pullback to Anchored VWAP
theses.precondition: Price holds above the VWAP anchored to the weekly open, pulls back within 0.4% of it, and funding stays positive but under 0.01%.
